description: Warehouse forklift agent modeled on Section 2.3: reaches the middle shelf and carries heavy items. These are scenario capabilities, not a claim of implemented forklift hardware control. Limits: Middle-shelf retrieval and heavy-item transport; no top-shelf or flight capability is advertised. Capability does not grant access: protected resources require a valid, unrevoked permission for the authorized task interval. Core capabilities are reach_middle_shelf and carry_heavy_items. The supplementary deliver_to_safe_zone skill adds gate traversal and placement in the designated zone when the task requires them. Retrieval and transport suitability depend on the core skills; delivery alone does not establish suitability. Execution uses the shared simulated workflow, subject to SST access permissions and the stated shelf and payload limits.
name: Forklift Agent

skills.name: Reach middle shelf
skills.description: Access to a middle-shelf storage location to retrieve target item.
examples: Retrieve an authorized target item from the middle shelf.

skills.name: Carry heavy items
examples: Carry an authorized heavy target item retrieved from the middle shelf.

skills.name: Supplementary delivery to designated zone
skills.description: Supplement reach_middle_shelf and carry_heavy_items with gate traversal and placement in the designated zone. For a retrieval-and-delivery task, use these skills together: reach_middle_shelf covers shelf access, carry_heavy_items covers item transport, and deliver_to_safe_zone covers the gate and destination steps. This supplementary skill does not independently provide retrieval, shelf reach, or payload capability, and is not required for tasks that only concern the core skills. The shared simulated execution workflow coordinates the combined task. Delivery requires valid SST access to both the item and gate; shelf-reach and payload limits still apply.
examples: Combine reach_middle_shelf, carry_heavy_items, and deliver_to_safe_zone to retrieve a heavy item from the middle shelf and deliver it through the gate to the designated zone.
